products.name: GoGuardian Beacon
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: Machine-learning classifier on browsing, search, email, apps. Use: Suicide and self-harm alerting on school devices. Who: District administrators, counselors. Student age: School-issued devices of enrolled students. Privacy: District contract; school staff decide on every alert; optional 24/7 human specialist tier. Price: Tiers: Beacon Starter (announced free with GoGuardian Admin in 2020), Core, and 24/7; confirm current pricing by quote. Caution: Free Starter tier dates from a 2020 announcement.

profile_text.body:
GoGuardian describes itself as a provider of tools for K-12 school leaders, aimed at creating safe and engaging learning for students. On its own site the company says it helps over 70% of top districts and that it has spent a decade delivering solutions that meet districts where they are on their AI adoption journey, with AI systems aligned to educational objectives and with privacy and data protection integrated into development and deployment.

The product tracked for GoGuardian is GoGuardian Beacon, described as a machine-learning classifier that works across browsing, search, email, and apps. Its stated use is suicide and self-harm alerting on school devices, for district administrators and counselors, covering school-issued devices of enrolled students. The site describes proactive AI detection that spots warning signs of self-harm or violence so staff can assess risk and act quickly. Privacy is handled through district contracts, school staff decide on every alert, and there is an optional 24/7 human specialist tier. Pricing is listed in tiers, Beacon Starter, Core, and 24/7, with Starter announced as free alongside GoGuardian Admin in 2020, and current pricing to be confirmed by quote.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or SEC and patent facts are recorded for the company.
